compiler_decision.reason: The measured legal-text compiler lowers a single document to deontic/canonical IR with a caller-supplied vocabulary and source map. It is fail-closed, use_ml=False, and does not take pairwise similarity as input. Compilation walks typed sparse edges (CITES, HAS_DOCKET, HAS_RIN, PUBLISHED_ON, HAS_PROVENANCE) via two-way adjacency. Embedding/BM25 neighbors are retrieval proposals only and cannot establish legal authority. A dense NxN matrix is neither an IR nor a walk index; materializing 1e6^2 cosine cells would be ~4TiB and would not make the compiler more correct.
